settings.title: User Settings
settings.language_description: Choose your display language. It must be one of the languages enabled for this realm. Leave empty to use the realm primary language.
settings.email_description: Add a personal email address to receive realm notifications. We will send a 6-digit code to verify it. You can turn email delivery off at any time.
settings.email_enable_help: When off, you will not receive emails even if the realm has email enabled.
settings.quarter_switch_help: Switch among quarters you already belong to. This updates session routing and your local home cache — it does not create a new membership.
settings.quarter_no_memberships: No quarter memberships found for this principal.
settings.quarter_register_help: Create a membership on a quarter you are not yet part of, then make it active. This is intentional multi-registration — not the open join picker.
settings.quarter_all_joined: You are already a member of every active quarter, or none are available to join.
settings.quarter_invite_required_body: This quarter requires an invitation code. Use an invite link to register there, then return here to activate it.
settings.quarter_registered_body: Registered in {label} and set it as the active quarter.
settings.email_code_sent_body: Check your inbox for a 6-digit code.

gate.anonymous_body: Check back soon. If you are the creator, sign in to continue setup.
gate.creator_title: {name} is being set up by its creator.
gate.creator_body: The creator is finishing initial configuration. Please check back later.

wizard.founding_line: You are founding a realm — a digital polity whose rules and processes are verifiable and tamper-proof. Choose how it governs, what it values, and how it looks — then bring it to life.
wizard.languages_help: Choose the languages this realm supports. The primary language is the default for everyone who has not picked their own.
wizard.primary_must_be_enabled: The primary language must be one of the enabled languages.
wizard.codex_help: Pick the governance package that defines how this realm runs.
wizard.token_help: Choose a token, or add your own ICRC-1 ledger.
wizard.branding_help: Write the realm's voice first. Then generate a mark, or upload your own.
wizard.welcome_placeholder: A short greeting shown under the realm name
wizard.random_hint: Each press draws a new random mark and backdrop from the realm name and manifesto.
wizard.review_help: These choices will be installed together. You can still go back and change them.

identities.public_data_help: This information is visible to all community members.

identities.data_sharing_help: Choose who may read your private data — realm administrators and/or specific departments. Sharing is consent-based: your data stays encrypted, and access is granted by wrapping your encryption key for each recipient. You can revoke at any time.
identities.sharing_requires_encryption: Sharing requires encryption, which is not available on this subnet.
identities.no_share_audiences: There are no administrators or departments available to share with yet.
